# android-sdk — the Android SDK toolchain candy

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Install root | `/opt/android-sdk` |
| Requires | `@github.com/opencharly/layer-java-openjdk` (JDK 21) |
| Env | `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` = `/opt/android-sdk` |
| System image | API-36 `google_apis_playstore` x86_64 (sdkmanager-fetched) |

## What it installs

From CachyOS/Arch packages under `/opt/android-sdk`:
`cmdline-tools` (`sdkmanager`/`avdmanager`), `platform-tools` (`adb`),
`build-tools` 36 (`aapt2`), `platform android-36`, and the `emulator`.
`apkeep` (the by-package-name app downloader the `charly check adb
install-app` verb drives) is installed from its upstream precompiled
x86_64 binary. The one component with no package anywhere — the API-36
`google_apis_playstore` x86_64 system image — is fetched by `sdkmanager`
into a persistent cache and copied alongside the tools.

## Usage

Compose it in a box (a named box's `candy:` value is the box BODY):

```yaml
android-dev:
  candy:
    base: cachyos-base
    candy:
      - '@github.com/opencharly/layer-android-sdk:v2026.xxx.yyyy'
```

The SDK lands at fixed paths under `/opt/android-sdk`, so it is verifiable
by probing those paths and running `adb version`. Pair it with an
emulator device (`kind: android`) and the `adb:`/`appium:` check verbs.

## Verification

`plan:` `check:` steps assert `/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager`,
`.../platform-tools/adb`, `.../build-tools/36.0.0/aapt2`, `.../emulator/emulator`,
`.../platforms/android-36`, and the fetched system-image directory all exist,
that `adb version` reports the Android Debug Bridge banner, and that `apkeep`
resolves on PATH.
